name: 悬挂式岩板一体陶瓷盆浴室柜款

shots.intent: 首屏一眼看清悬挂柜体与双圆镜的对称结构，建立品类认知与高级感。
shots.textZone: top-left clean zone for headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and subline 「{selling_point_2}」

shots.intent: 用离地留空的实景化解柜底难擦难清的顾虑，同时交代整体比例。
放大湿区台面堆满瓶罐、拿取混乱的痛点，为分区收纳的解法铺垫。
shots.textZone: top centre clean strip for headline 「{callout_1}」 and label 「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 用六宫格图标一次讲全结构卖点，方便横向扫读比选。
shots.textZone: two columns by three rows, one short label under each icon

shots.intent: 侧面看清盆台过渡与釉面质感，把做工信任落到可见细节。
特写环形出光与可调光色，把梳妆镜的实用卖点讲透。
shots.textZone: centred lower band on a dark translucent bar for labels 「{callout_1} / {callout_2} / {callout_3}」

shots.intent: 展示门板分格与把手形，让买家确认储物分区与开启方式。
shots.textZone: left clean zone for headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and label 「{selling_point_2}」

shots.intent: 以门板样块阵列表达面材可选，解决风格搭配的选择焦虑。
shots.textZone: lower third with two rows of thin capsule outlines holding label pairs 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」

shots.intent: 把产品放回真实卫生间，用低机位氛围图补足风格说服力与种草感。
交代柜体如何上墙、收边如何过渡，用可见结构回应安装与稳固疑问。
用四宫格卡片并列陈列不同柜体与镜柜形态，把选款决策收拢到最后一屏。
shots.textZone: each card carries a bold title placeholder 「{selling_point_1}」…「{selling_point_4}」 with a small grey subline under it

style.backgroundSystem: tiled wet-zone wall at #D8D9D6 crossed by a horizontal brushed-stainless rail at #B6BBC0; matte floor, no wood-grain wall lining
style.iconSystem: thin brushed-stainless line icons held inside square brackets, 1.5px stroke, unfilled, no rounded cartoon shapes
style.lightingSystem: even 5600K diffuse ceiling wash, low contrast, large soft source; the mirror ring reads as a #E8D9C0 glow with no hotspot; contact shadows short, soft-edged and always present under the cabinet and the basins
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent cool minimal wet-zone bathroom visual system across the whole image set; fixed palette of #D8D9D6, #8FA0AE, #F4F6F6, #B6BBC0 plus one mirror-glow accent #E8D9C0; cool 5600K even diffuse lighting, low contrast, soft short contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; thin brushed-stainless line icons in square brackets; clean product photography mixed with sparse infographic panels; stable product scale and placement with true vertical lines; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no brand names, wordmarks, logos, watermarks or QR codes
no prices, discounts, coupons or shipping-time text
no panel grade, E0/ENF wording or formaldehyde values
no waterproof rating, load capacity, dimensions or warranty years
no hardware brand names, certificates, test reports or award badges
no water-pooling under-cabinet test, no child climbing on shelves
no wall-hung unit shown without visible fixing brackets
no sagging or overloaded shelf boards
no invented copy, ratings, sales counts or percentage charts
style.presentationRules: keep every vertical line truly vertical and the horizon level, cabinet facade parallel to the frame in front views; stable product share of frame; each scene includes one real bathroom object (basin, bottle, cup or towel) to anchor true scale
style.surfaceSystem: matte rectified ceramic tile with grout joints kept parallel and true; satin-glazed vessel basin at #F4F6F6; slim slab door faces with fine vein; brushed stainless rails, faucet and brackets
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, heavy headline with a regular-weight subline, wide letter spacing, copy placed only in defined left or top clean zones
